A '''memorial service''' was held for [[Raana Tey]] after she died in the destruction of the [[Jedi Tower]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Although her body was not recovered, a statue was erected in a rooftop garden of the [[Draay Estate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The service was interrupted when the remaining Seers of the [[First WatchCircle]] had a vision of the future.
